## Critique
- claim-1: The cited excerpt supports exactly the stated ideal-generating family. It does not establish the integral Schur-basis decomposition of \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), the quotient Littlewood–Richardson rule, or the required torsion-free direct sum.
- claim-2: The Pieri enumeration and reduction to the ten rows are mathematically plausible and cover the three boundary regimes. However, the proof is conditional on an ungrounded ambient presentation. In particular, the assertion that the interval Schur span is an ideal needs the quotient Littlewood–Richardson rule and the argument \(c_{\lambda\mu}^{\nu}\ne0\Rightarrow\mu\subseteq\nu\), using LR symmetry. The direct-sum equality also requires integral linear independence of the in-box Schur classes. These facts are neither proved nor supported by claim-1. The homogeneous reduction should explicitly replace \(a_\ell m\) by its degree-\((d+4-\ell)\) component and use \(M_t=0\) for \(t<d\). Thus the requested target is established only conditionally on the stated integral box-Schur/LR/Pieri presentation, not unconditionally. No prohibited determinant, higher-degree, or minimality conclusion is made.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] Prove that in \(A=\Lambda/I_{j+1,i+1}\), the in-box Schur classes form a free \(\mathbb Z\)-basis and multiplication is the box-truncated LR rule; then prove
  \[
  \bigl(s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i+1)^{j+1}\bigr)
  =\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\nu\subseteq(i+1)^{j+1}}\mathbb Zs_\nu
  \]
  by \(c_{\lambda\mu}^{\nu}\ne0\Rightarrow\mu\subseteq\nu\).
- [computation] Supply a machine-checkable horizontal-strip enumeration for \((i,j)=(3,3),(3,4),(4,3)\), listing all ten products and confirming that their coordinate vectors are exactly \(C_u+C_{u+1}\), with unavailable boundary columns deleted.
- [source-refresh] Supply a stable formal-source excerpt establishing the integral in-box Schur basis and quotient LR/Pieri multiplication for \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\); source-2@L1365-L1375 establishes only the generating family.

## Required revisions
- State the ambient presentation as either proved/source-backed or an explicit hypothesis.
- Add the LR-containment and Schur-independence argument needed for the first displayed equality.
- Make the homogeneous \(A_+\)-product reduction degreewise explicit.
- State that the requested target is conditional unless the missing presentation certificate is supplied.
